text: > My suggestion is to find gaps that aren't integration efforts, if possible, that are instead extension efforts. Yes! In general, if the glue person has intermediate knowledge of the codebase, they'd get promoted without much controversy. In such a case, it should not be difficult for them to bang out a couple of features and ship it, for example. [0] [VIDEO]
